$comment: The rendered box a team-card headshot is squeezed into on campus pages, measured read-only with Playwright on 2026-09-22 (tests/photo-framing.mjs measureTeamCardsInPage, desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844). Every card image renders with object-fit: cover into a box of fixed CSS height whose width follows the column, so the ratio is per page and per viewport, not one site value: San Francisco's carousel is 1.29:1 on desktop, Santa Barbara's 1.61:1, Miami's 1.46:1, and the same boxes are 1.09:1, 0.91:1 and 1.25:1 on mobile. Rule (protocols/recipes/staff-card.md, docs/headshot-binding.md): a headshot is framed to the desktop carousel ratio of the page it goes on, measured on that page (agent/frame-headshot.mjs --ratio auto --page <url>), never to a constant; the mobile box then cuts only the sides, symmetrically, which the team-photo-framing check tolerates up to 30% per edge. Framing to the card ratio remains how a headshot is prepared; since 2026-10-01 the check no longer fails a card for not being at that ratio, only for cutting the top of the portrait. Leadership boxes vary more (San Francisco follows the image, Santa Barbara and Miami fix the height) and are measured with --selector. Re-measure when the Elementor team template changes; the check reads the live box every run and does not depend on these numbers.

rule.frameTo: desktop carousel card box of the target page, measured live
rule.check: tests/page-check.mjs team-photo-framing (tests/photo-framing.mjs); a card fails when the crop removes more than maxTopCut of the image height from the TOP, or under minVisibleHeight of the height is visible, or a side cut passes horizontalMaxEdgeCut; a top-anchored portrait cropped only at the bottom passes
rule.thresholdNote: Decision 2026-10-01 (Matt Barge), superseding the verticalMinCoverage 0.95 of 2026-09-22: a card fails when the box plausibly clips the head, not when the file is larger than the box. maxTopCut 0.08 sits in the empty band between the largest hairline top cut measured on 2026-10-01 (0.0082, two New York cards at 50% 50%) and the one real clip (0.2848 and 0.3971, Fort Worth Kimberley Dillard at 50% 100%, crown gone). minVisibleHeight 0.4 is below the shallowest card the contact sheets confirmed correct (0.4299, Palm Beach Dr. Tasha Arnold desktop, top-anchored, head whole), so it never fails a card that looks right; 0.55 would have failed that card and Plano (0.5911) and Chantilly (0.6535). Side limits unchanged. Measurements: marketingsupport work-assets/apex-website-tickets/reframe-2026-10-01/measure/measure-live.json, 112 card-viewport readings over seven pages.
